direct_claims: This chart is about the share of British adults who smoke cigarettes or use vapes/e-cigarettes.

The note states that cigarette-use data are based on adults aged 16 years and older, whereas vape-use data are based on those aged 18 years and older.
The note also says that for vaping, any usage is considered, including occasional use.
The chart includes only shares of adults, not the absolute number of people using cigarettes or vapes.
The image provides approximate trend information, but without the underlying data table, exact year-by-year values cannot be recovered with certainty.
